{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I've seen unwary travellers looking for nothing more than a cold beverage burned down for inadvertently insulting the wrong person. When you're dealing with these 'fringe operators,' you ''have'' to know the most important rule:<br />Never start a fight you don't intend to finish.|[[Sherbin Tork]]|<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
"'''The fringe'''" was a term used to describe the shady underbelly of society in which [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[black marketeer]]s, [[Thief/Legends|thieves]], and assorted criminals operated.<ref name="Heir to the Empire Sourcebook">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
